## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
I found one defect that should block the merge: the release gate now rejects a release that has exactly the required number of approvals. The `healthy()` rewrite gives the same result as before for the list inputs that `tests/test_release.py` passes. The catalog regeneration renames all 1,500 entries and moves their ports from 10000–11499 to 20000–21499. Nothing in the repository outside `aaa-generated/` reads `catalog.json`, so those changes reach no code path that can be checked here.

## Critical
- zzz-release/gate.py:5 — correctness — `approved()` changes `approvals >= minimum` to `approvals > minimum`, so `approved(2)` (exactly the default minimum) now returns `False`. That contradicts the module docstring at `zzz-release/gate.py:1`: "A release needs at least the configured number of approvals." The tests only check 3 approvals (`tests/test_release.py:12`) and 1 approval (`tests/test_release.py:16`), so they never hit this boundary. Can you restore `>=` and add `assert gate.approved(2, minimum=2)`? — Every release with exactly the required number of approvals is blocked, including the common case of 2 approvals under the default, and the current tests still pass.

## Important
(none)

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- `tests/test_release.py:19-21` covers both branches of the rewritten `healthy()` (an empty list and a one-item failure list). `not failures` returns the same result as `len(failures) == 0` for both.

## Not reviewed
- `aaa-generated/catalog.json`: I didn't read pinned-diff lines 2234–8984 line by line. I checked them with pattern searches instead. Lines that are neither name/port lines nor the unchanged `"enabled": true` / `},` lines appear only at the end of the file, and the name/port lines total exactly 6,000 (1,500 entries × 2 old/new names and 2 old/new ports). I read the start and end of the file at `pr-25` directly.
- `services/registry.py`: I didn't read lines 1–69 at `pr-25` (unchanged entries in the `SERVICES` dict above the hunk).
- Anything outside this repository that consumes `aaa-generated/catalog.json`, such as deployment tooling that looks services up by the old `legacy-service-NNNN` names or ports 10000–11499. Nothing in this repository reads the file, so the effect of the renames and port changes can't be checked here.
